eBilling Flow

Excess split, approval matrix, 15th rule, Oracle deduction

← Approval Request

Monthly calendar

All cut-offs use Asia/Dubai. The employee has until the end of the 15th. The system applies the default rule at 16th 00:00. Approvals freeze and Oracle posts at 18th 00:00.

Until 15th 23:59
Employee windowSplit the excess, or correct a rejected split.
16th 00:00
Default ruleIf the request reached them and they did not submit: full excess becomes personal.
Until 17th 23:59
Matrix still openAudit / L2 / L3 can approve or reject submitted splits.
18th 00:00
Payroll cut-offApprovals freeze. Personal amounts post to Oracle Other Deduction. Report to Sona / Vinod.
